title: Multi-Agent Error Propagation x Single-Point Monitoring: One Hijack, Many Defections

original_idea.body: Build a 3-agent pipeline with a monitor at one configurable position, inject a goal-hijack at the first agent, and measure caught-harm as a function of monitor placement.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Monitor placement vs goal-hijack propagation in multi-agent pipelines is a defensible control-design chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 3-agent pipeline plus configurable monitor; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused caught-harm-vs-placement measurement; pipeline is one dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable multi-agent harness, public models, lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: Open-model inference across a small pipeline.

novelty.reasoning: Multi-agent propagation studied; the monitor-placement-coverage framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Multi-agent propagation studied; monitor-placement quantification may be open.
